description: I am an energetic elementary school student and space enthusiast who dreams of exploring the cosmos! Proving that we are never too young to tackle big galactic ideas, I bring a new perspective, limitless curiosity, and a deep love for astronomy to this year's NASA International Space Apps Challenge. I am completely fascinated by planets, stars, space, and black holes. Guided by this excitement for space exploration, I am here to learn, create, and show that great innovations can start at any age
